controls_what: The controls Find anything draws, each a show-rules `control` (parts/ui/show/show-rules show-of.ts controlShown): each place results come from (src/workspace/command-palette.json `sources`) is `palette.source.<its id>` and each action is `palette.action.<its id>`, so one rule on `palette` holds for every row and a new source or action needs no code.

controls.label: Results Find anything shows, each place by its id (palette.source.screens)
Actions Find anything offers, each by its id (palette.action.ask)
